title: SMS Marketing for Accountants & CPA Firms: 2027 Guide

facts.fact: According to the AICPA (2025), SMS open rates reach roughly 98% versus about 20% for email.
facts.quote: SMS open rates reach roughly 98% versus about 20% for email according to the AICPA (2025).

facts.fact: According to the Journal of Accountancy 2025 close-cycle benchmark, the average month-end close still consumes five to six business days at many firms.
facts.quote: the average month-end close still consumes five to six business days at many firms

facts.fact: According to Thomson Reuters 2025 Tax Season Pulse, firms hit peak preparer utilization above 90% during the final filing weeks.
facts.quote: firms hit peak preparer utilization above 90% during the final filing weeks

facts.fact: The guide's target audience is firms with 5 to 75 staff and a defined client list of 200+ returns or recurring engagements.
facts.quote: Firm size:** 5 to 75 staff with a defined client list of 200+ returns or recurring engagements.

facts.fact: The guide's target audience has annual fees between $500K and $15M.
The guide recommends skipping SMS marketing software if a firm has fewer than 50 active clients.
facts.quote: Skip SMS marketing software if you have fewer than 50 active clients

facts.fact: The guide states that under the TCPA, accounting firms need prior express consent to text clients and should keep an auditable record of it.
facts.quote: Yes — under the TCPA you need prior express consent, and you should keep an auditable record of it.

facts.fact: The guide recommends keeping each SMS template under 160 characters and including a clear reply action.
facts.quote: Keep each under 160 characters and include a clear reply action.

facts.fact: The guide recommends that firms register business numbers for A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration with carriers so messages are not filtered as spam.
facts.quote: Complete A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration with the carriers so your messages are not filtered as spam.

facts.fact: A mid-size firm modeled in the playbook saw client replies arrive the same day after moving document reminders from email to two-way SMS, instead of three days later.
facts.quote: moved document reminders from email to two-way SMS and saw replies arrive the same day instead of three days later

facts.fact: The page's cost table lists the typical platform monthly fee for SMS tools at $25 to $150.
The page's cost table gives the per-message rate for SMS platforms as fractions of a cent each.
facts.quote: Per-message rate | Fractions of a cent each

facts.fact: The page states that under the TCPA a firm must collect prior express consent before texting clients.
facts.quote: Under the TCPA you must collect prior express consent before texting clients

facts.fact: The page's glossary states that a client's opt-out request to stop texts must be honored immediately.
facts.quote: A client's request to stop receiving texts, which must be honored immediately.

facts.fact: The page states that registering for A2P 10DLC protects deliverability and is effectively required for sustained campaign sending.
facts.quote: registering protects deliverability and is effectively required for sustained campaign sending
